gen-gf-warnes-gf-martel-sans: Warnes draws tubelike strokes that never vary in thickness, with tips that taper out before touching. Martel Sans follows in a plain sans with openings in every curve and a high mean line, so the heading's stretched spacing has a steadier partner.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-matangi: Fat, spaced-out, unmistakably loud. Matangi has a hefty lowercase of rounded, twine-like strokes, so if Warnes were shrunk to body size its tapering ink ends would crowd in and lose the bold impact.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-maven-pro: Expressive is Warnes all over, with ink strokes that taper out before touching and no thick-to-thin shift at all. And Maven Pro keeps a gentle monotone line and an open gap in the c, so a long run of text stays easy to move through.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-michroma: Bold is the mood Warnes sets, its stems and curves cut from one gauge of tubing and spaced wide. And Michroma gives each letter a wide berth too, so the shared spaciousness becomes the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre brings a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, drawn with the weight of a wire. And under Warnes, whose ink strokes taper out before touching, a long passage reads approachably, with an s that keeps its bends open.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads big and round, a very large lowercase eye hung out like clothespins on a line. And with Warnes above it, stretched and bold, a long passage keeps a steady, laser-cut sameness of stroke.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One has a sizable lowercase and wide blank gaps between its letters, with no brush-like swell anywhere. But Warnes shares that spacious feel, and its constant-weight tubelike strokes make the pair's strongest quality a clean, generous openness.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline reads with hollow-reed counters and round bowls whose walls never swell, its lowercase oversized beside the capitals. And across a longer stretch it stays orderly beneath Warnes, whose tapering ink strokes carry all the expression.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mozilla-headline: Warnes has no thick-to-thin variation at all, just tubelike lines stretched across spacious tracking. Mozilla Headline answers with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall bodies and flared terminals. Warnes does the loud work, with bold, constant-width lines and stretched spacing, while the sans handles the reading with lowercase that looks sturdy.
